The '''Third Mid Rim Army''', also known as the '''3rd Sector Army''', '''Steel Blade Command'''<ref name="TEGTW" /> or simply the '''Third Army''',<ref name="CW22" /><ref name="TEGtW-AC9" /> was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of [[Sector 3 (Oversector)|Sector 3]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> The [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]] was generally considered one of the Third [[Army/Legends|Army's]] best units.<ref name="TEGtW-AC9" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Republic, the 3rd Sector Army was intended to be a reserve unit for [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] operations. As such, it was given responsibility for patrol along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. It often worked alongside the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]] extensively during the conflict.<ref name="TEGTW" /> In [[19 BBY]], towards the end of the conflict, the Third Army fell under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], alongside [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Cody]]. It participated in a [[Battle of unidentified planet (shielded city)|battle]] on a Separatist-controlled [[Unidentified planet (shielded city)|planet]], home to a [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="CW22" />
